sentences.text: Notice was issued to revisionist to engage another counsel vide Court's order dated 28.07.2017.
None appeared on behalf of revisionist.

2. This criminal revision under Section 401 read with Section 397 Cr.P.C. has been filed aggrieved by judgment and order dated 14.05.1991 passed by Sri S.M.Sharma, Vth Additional Sessions Judge,
Muzaffarnagar,in Criminal Appeal No.10 of 1988 whereby appeal was dismissed and judgment and order dated 15.1.1988 passed by Special Judicial Magistrate (Economic Offences) Kairana district Muzaffarnagar in Criminal Case No.352/9 of 1984 in which revisionist was convicted under Section 7/16, 1 A-2 of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act with fine of Rs.200 and under Section 7/16, 1 A-1 for six months rigorous imprisonment and fine of Rs.1000/-, in default of payment of fine to further undergo imprisonment of one month has been confirmed.

3. Having gone through the record, I do not find any manifest error or otherwise illegality,
procedural or otherwise, so as to justify interference in criminal revision.

Mabin vs State on 10 July, 2019 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/105645476/

Notice was issued to revisionist to engage another counsel vide Court's order dated 28.07.2017.
Service is deemed sufficient.
2. This criminal revision under Section 401 read with Section 397 Cr.P.C. has been filed aggrieved by judgment and order dated 14.05.1991 passed by Sri S.M.Sharma, Vth Additional Sessions Judge,
Muzaffarnagar,in Criminal Appeal No.10 of 1988 whereby appeal was dismissed and judgment and order dated 15.1.1988 passed by Special Judicial Magistrate (Economic Offences) Kairana district Muzaffarnagar in Criminal Case No.352/9 of 1984 in which revisionist was convicted under Section 7/16, 1 A-2 of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act with fine of Rs.200 and under Section 7/16, 1 A-1 for six months rigorous imprisonment and fine of Rs.1000/-, in default of payment of fine to further undergo imprisonment of one month has been confirmed.
4. Dismissed.
